tool.name: krepp place
tool.description: phylogenetic placement of query sequences on a backbone tree
tool.command:
mkdir -p index_dir && tar -xf '$index' -C index_dir &&
krepp place -i index_dir -q '$query' --num-threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} #if $nwk_tree: -t '$nwk_tree' #end if #if $lineage_file: -l '$lineage_file' #end if #if $output_mode == 'no_multi': --no-multi #elif $output_mode == 'summarize': --summarize #end if #if $filter: --filter #end if #if $output_format == 'tabular': --tabular #end if --tau $tau -o '$output'

param.name: index
param.label: Krepp index
param.help: Index archive produced by krepp index

param.name: query
param.label: Query sequences
param.help: FASTA or FASTQ file containing query sequences

param.name: nwk_tree
param.label: Backbone tree (optional)
param.help: Override the backbone tree embedded in the index

param.name: lineage_file
param.label: Taxonomic lineages file (optional)
param.help: Alternative to a tree: tab-separated file with taxonomic lineages

param.label: Filter weak placements
param.help: Filter out placements with insufficient k-mer support

param.label: K-mer match threshold
param.help: Minimum number of k-mer matches required for a placement to be retained (used with --filter)

tool.help:
**What it does**
Performs phylogenetic placement of query sequences on a backbone tree using a pre-built krepp index. Placement uses maximum pseudo-likelihood to find the optimal position for each query sequence on the reference phylogeny.
**Output**
- **jplace**: JSON format compatible with downstream tools like gappa and iTOL. Contains placement edges, likelihoods, and pendant lengths. - **Tabular**: Tab-separated format with columns: EDGE_NUM, LIKELIHOOD, LIKE_WEIGHT_RATIO, DISTAL_LENGTH, PENDANT_LENGTH, SEQ_ID.
**Options**
- **Backbone tree**: Override the tree embedded in the index. - **Lineage file**: Use taxonomic lineages instead of a tree. - **Multiple placements**: Report multiple placements per read (default) or only the best. - **Filter**: Remove placements with insufficient k-mer support. - **Tau**: Minimum k-mer matches required when filtering.
@ATTRIBUTION@
